title: pvAnnotateAttributeData
body:
## pvAnnotateAttributeData

Produces a one-cell text table showing Prefix followed by one value of an array: element ElementId of the chosen point, cell, field or row array, taken from MPI rank ProcessId. Use it to label an image with a probe value or a global quantity such as a residual. Input must be a non-composite dataset or a table; ParaView needs its Python support for this filter.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Composite datasets are not supported; extract a block first (extractBlock).
- ElementId indexes the array's tuples from 0; check the index after any filter that reorders points or cells.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AnnotateAttributeData`. Identity: `filters/AnnotateAttributeData`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the input of the filter. To avoid the complications/confusion when identifying elements in a composite dataset, this filter doesn't support composite datasets currently. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); tables (rows and columns) (vtkTable). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":false,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkTable"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ElementId` | Set the element index to annotate with. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Prefix` | Text that is used as a prefix to the field value | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ProcessId` | Set the process rank to extract element from. | `{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0` |
| `SelectInputArray` | This property indicates the name of the array from which to obtain the annotation value. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json

  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAnnotateAttributeData",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
